title: Completeness of integer multiplicity currents under mass convergence (Simon 3.13)
statement: Completeness of integer multiplicity currents (Simon 3.13). For N, k ∈ ℕ, let T ∈ D_k(ℝ^N) and let T_j ∈ D_k(ℝ^N) (j ∈ ℕ) be integer multiplicity currents such that for every ε > 0 there is J with M(D) < ε for every j ≥ J and every current D with D(ω) = T(ω) − T_j(ω) for all test forms ω (i.e. M(T − T_j) → 0). Then T is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k) (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j)) → (∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ J : ℕ, ∀ j, J ≤ j → ∀ D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ ω, D ω = T ω - Tj j ω) → D.mass < ε) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
